assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is PR-204.
The denied service is CPT code 93271.
CPT 93271 corresponds to Cardiac Event Monitoring.
The payer letter states the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's condition.
The patient has a history of recurrent palpitations.
The patient has had episodes of syncope.
These symptoms raise concern for underlying arrhythmia.
The submitted diagnosis codes are I47.1, I48.0, and R55.
Clinical evaluation suggests paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential etiology.
Clinical evaluation suggests supraventricular tachycardia as a potential etiology.
A cardiac event monitor was ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management.
The diagnosis codes were submitted with the claim.
